name: Habibur Rahman
headline: Operations Leader | Cosmetics Team Lead at Carvana | Former Operations Manager at Kyte | Process Improvement

experiences.description: Lead daily cosmetic department operations across prep, body, paint, primer, and sanding while ensuring vehicles meet Carvana quality and reconditioning standards. Supervise team workflow, assign production priorities, support daily output targets, coach associates, monitor repair quality, enforce safety standards, provide hands-on support when needed, and maintain strong department performance through accountability, consistency, and attention to detail.

As Line Lead of the Detail and Quality Check Department at Carvana, I oversee daily operations to ensure every vehicle meets the company’s high standards for presentation and condition before delivery to customers. I supervise and coordinate a team of detailers and quality inspectors on the production line, ensuring efficiency, accuracy, and adherence to safety protocols.

My responsibilities include assigning tasks, monitoring workflow, and verifying that vehicles pass through each stage of the detailing and inspection process seamlessly. I inspect final work for cleanliness, cosmetic perfection, and quality compliance, ensuring vehicles are ready for customer delivery or lot placement. I also communicate closely with management and other departments to resolve issues quickly, maintain productivity goals, and support continuous process improvement.
